method.branchRule: no-duplicated-branches compares if-chain branches and switch cases token by token and needs the duplicate to span more than one line (braces excluded).
method.imports: import and re-export declarations excluded from the token stream
method.sonarIdenticalFunctions: same file; Type-1 body; body spans >= 3 lines (braces excluded); FunctionDeclaration, functions assigned to variables, class methods; each later duplicate reported once
method.thresholds: 50 tokens and 5 lines are jscpd's defaults (docs/rust.md at kucherenko/jscpd@19f2c885); 100 tokens is maven-pmd-plugin's CPD default (CpdReport.java at apache/maven-pmd-plugin@8250c2ab; PMD's own CLI makes --minimum-tokens mandatory); Svajlenko & Roy (arXiv:2006.15682) give 30-100 tokens and 6-15 lines as typical minimums. CCFinder's manual makes the minimum length mandatory without a default.
method.type1: identical tokens (typescript-estree), layout and comments ignored
